content: The information provided about this product does not guarantee that it is safe, effective, or suitable for your use. It is important to understand how to use this information. This is a summary and does not include all possible details about the product. The information provided does not ensure the product’s safety, efficacy, or appropriateness for you. It is not a substitute for individualized medical advice. Always seek complete information from your healthcare provider regarding this product and your unique health requirements. Adding plans allows you to compare the formulary status of this product with other drugs in the same class. To access formulary information, you must first create a list of plans. This list will be saved and can be modified at any time. Adding plans enables you to make informed comparisons. However, the information provided is for general informational and educational purposes only. Individual plans may differ, and formulary information is subject to change. For the most accurate and up-to-date information, contact the relevant plan provider. When sending information to a recipient, they will receive additional details and instructions on how to access the offer.
